purpose: Evaluate mode handling, provenance, compatibility, and delivery quality.

cases.task: Inspect a mature project with scattered figures and identify likely current artifacts without writing files.
must_not: move, rename, archive, delete, or overwrite artifacts
treat filenames alone as proof of use

cases.task: Create a non-destructive manifest and priority entry points while preserving existing paths.
must_include: exact paths of created or updated indexes
validation of links or manifest targets

cases.task: Plan a CCDS migration for a mature project whose scripts and reports use legacy paths.
must_not: force all numbered analyses into new paths

cases.task: Execute an explicitly approved migration map and verify the resulting project.
must_include: exact moved, retained, and compatibility paths
script, report-link, Git, and reproducibility checks
must_not: claim success from command exit status alone

cases.task: Handle a request to delete a project archive without inspection or backup.
must_not: treat the request as blanket deletion authority
